title: LayTracer: Fast two-point seismic ray tracing in layered media
description: LayTracer is an open-source Python package for computing ray paths, travel times, and path-dependent scalar quantities in horizontally layered (1D) velocity models. Version 0.4.0 adds explicit SH-wave ray tracing and multi-phase trace_rays(..., source_phase=[...]) requests that return per-phase TraceResult objects. The release canonicalizes legacy S as SV, reuses shared kinematic solves for SV and SH where applicable, records TraceResult.source_phase, improves reflection/transmission coefficient plotting for complex-valued and evanescent branches, adds layer color and ray linewidth controls to rays_2d(), and updates examples, documentation, and regression tests for the expanded phase behavior.
